_readme: English strings for the homepage app that are not written in index.html itself: words app.js shows at runtime (ui), the labels render-hub.sh prints on doors (labels), and the joining words narration-clips.sh uses to compose project scripts (narration).
English is the source language. The homepage text is index.html itself; each other language has an i18n/<lang>.json with the same keys plus a page map, and a journey.<lang>.json.
name: English
